mapper.insert: insert into proj_payment( project_id, payment_type, amount, pay_time, pay_unit, pay_method, invoice_no, invoice_date, invoice_amount, invoice_status, received_status, extra_data, remark, create_by, create_time )values( #{projectId}, #{paymentType}, #{amount}, #{payTime}, #{payUnit}, #{payMethod}, #{invoiceNo}, #{invoiceDate}, #{invoiceAmount}, #{invoiceStatus}, #{receivedStatus}, 'pending', #{extraData}::jsonb, null, #{remark}, #{createBy}, now() ) on conflict (project_id, payment_type) where del_flag = '0' and payment_type <> 'refund' do update set amount = EXCLUDED.amount, pay_time = EXCLUDED.pay_time, pay_unit = EXCLUDED.pay_unit, pay_method = EXCLUDED.pay_method, invoice_no = EXCLUDED.invoice_no, invoice_date = EXCLUDED.invoice_date, invoice_amount = EXCLUDED.invoice_amount, invoice_status = EXCLUDED.invoice_status, received_status = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.received_status, proj_payment.received_status, 'pending'), extra_data = EXCLUDED.extra_data, remark = EXCLUDED.remark, update_by = EXCLUDED.create_by, update_time = now()
mapper.sql: SELECT p.id AS "projectId", p.project_code AS "projectCode", p.project_name AS "projectName", p.client_unit AS "clientUnit", COALESCE(c.contract_amount, 0) AS "contractAmount", COALESCE(pa.received, 0) AS "receivedAmount", COALESCE(c.contract_amount, 0) - COALESCE(pa.received, 0) AS "unpaidAmount", CASE WHEN c.contract_amount IS NULL OR c.contract_amount = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(pa.received, 0) * 100.0 / c.contract_amount, 1) END AS "progress", CASE WHEN COALESCE(pa.received, 0) = 0 THEN 'unpaid' WHEN c.contract_amount IS NOT NULL AND c.contract_amount > 0 AND COALESCE(pa.received, 0) >= c.contract_amount THEN 'settled' ELSE 'partial' END AS "paymentStatus" FROM proj_project p LEFT JOIN proj_contract c ON c.id = p.contract_id AND c.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, SUM(CASE WHEN payment_type = 'refund' THEN -COALESCE(amount, 0) ELSE COALESCE(amount, 0) END) AS received FROM proj_payment WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY project_id ) pa ON pa.project_id = p.id WHERE p.del_flag = '0'
